**The build passes now.** Exit code 0.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read either key |
| [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat unset as off |

The 8 `WARN` lines are noise. They point at files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here. `build.js` prints them as fixed strings.
